counters.text: Meter haaki, anna. It comes to ₹80.
I'll come this way every day now. ₹100?

lines.concede: Okay, {amount}. Sit, sit — traffic is there.
lines.hold: Meter illa, saar. One-way trip, return empty. {total}.
lines.offended: Fifty? Walk, then. Good for health.
lines.final: {total}, last. Nine-thirty you want to reach, no?
lines.callback: Ey — okay, {amount}. Come. Don't tell the other drivers.
